Up to 6,000 people are expected to take part in the annual Walk with Christ Religious Procession which will travel from Martin Place to St Mary's Cathedral. Road closures and clearways will be in effect in the Sydney CBD between 1pm and 5pm from Martin Place to St Marys Cathedral.

Traffic will be heavy in the city while roads are closed. Motorists should avoid unnecessary travel through the city where possible or allow plenty of extra travel time.

Road closures:

  • From 2:30pm to 4:30pm sections of Pitt, O'Connell, Bligh, Spring, Castlereagh, Phillip, King, Elizabeth, George and Hunter Streets will close.
  • From 2:50pm to 4:30pm sections of College St, Macquarie St, Prince Albert Rd and St James Rd will close.

Special event clearways will be in effect from 1pm until 4pm on sections of College, Hunter, Macquarie and Pitt Streets. Clearways are strict no-parking zones and apply even to local residents and Mobility Scheme Permit Holders. Check signs carefully before parking as vehicles left in clearways will be towed and a fee applies.

properties.otherAdvice:
Vivid Sydney returns for its 15th year for 23 consecutive nights from Friday 23 May to Saturday 14 June and will be lighting up 5 key zones across the city.

The city is no place for cars with road closures and clearway parking restrictions in place each night in Circular Quay, The Rocks, Dawes Point, Millers Point and Ultimo between 3pm and midnight daily, and until 1am on Saturday nights.

Road closures:

  • Monday to Thursdays: from 3pm local roads in The Rocks, Millers Point and Dawes Point will close including sections of Lower Fort St, Merriman St and Rodens Ln. From 5pm additional roads will close including sections of George St, Argyle St, Harrington St, Pottinger St and Loftus St.
  • Fridays: additional closures will be in place from 3pm on High St, High Ln, Argyle Pl. From 5pm additional closures will be in place including all of Argyle St, and sections of Hickson Rd, George St, Essex St, Upper Fort St and Watson Rd. From 6pm roads in Circular Quay including Pitt, Loftus, Young, Albert and Phillip Streets will close as well as a section of Darling Dr in Ultimo. From 7pm lanes will close on Erskine St westbound and Kent St southbound.
  • Saturdays: local closures will be in place from 3pm, and mentioned key roads in Circular Quay, The Rocks, Millers Point, Dawes Point and Ultimo will close from 5pm. Additionally Grosvenor St/Bridge St between York St and Loftus St will be closed - no east/west access via Bridge St during this time. Roads remain closed until 1am on Saturdays. Wheat Rd will close from 7pm to 11pm.
  • 2pm Friday to 1am Monday: each weekend, George St will close between Lower Fort St and Hickson Rd for The Rocks markets. 

Special event clearways will be in effect on various roads between 3pm and midnight each day during Vivid Sydney on most major roads in the Sydney CBD, The Rocks, Circular Quay, Dawes Point and Haymarket. Some clearways will be in effect earlier from 1pm and 2pm on local roads.

Clearways are strict no-parking zones for all vehicle types, and apply even to local residents and TfNSW Mobility Scheme Permit holders. Check signs carefully as vehicles left in clearways will be towed and a fee applies. If your vehicle is towed, you can search your vehicle registration at the Find My Car website to find its new location, or alternatively call 132 701 to speak to an operator.

properties.otherAdvice:
Star Struck will be held on Friday 13 and Saturday 14 June at Newcastle Entertainment Centre.

Motorists are advised to expect delays on Griffiths Road at the entrance to the Newcastle Entertainment Centre as patrons travel to and from the event. The right hand turn from Griffiths Road into the venue will be restricted, causing delays for some motorists. Access to Chatham Road from Griffiths Road will also be restricted each day. Motorists should allow extra time and follow the directions from police and traffic controllers.

properties.publicTransport: Participants receive free travel on buses and trains for travel to and from the event. You will need to show your race number. Find out more or visit transportnsw.info to plan your trip.
properties.otherAdvice:
Changed traffic conditions will be in place for the Bay to Bay Running Festival will be held on Sunday 15 June from 6.30am between Woy Woy and Gosford.

Key roads will be closed for the event:

  • The Boulevarde, Woy Woy between Brisbane Water Drive and Brick Wharf Road from 5am Saturday 14 June to 9.20am Sunday 15 June.
  • Rolling closure of Brisbane Water Drive from Brick Wharf Road to Glenrock Parade with various side local roads that intersect with Brisbane Water Drive from 6.55am to 8.10am.
  • Riou Street, Gosford, southbound between Donnison Street and Central Coast Highway from 7.30am to 11.40am.
  • Dane Drive, Gosford, between Donnison Street and Georgiana Terrace from 6.50am to 1pm.
  • Alfred Higgs Place, Gosford between the roundabout on Central Coast Highway to the carpark underneath Brian McGowan Bridge from 5am to 1pm. 

Motorists travelling between Gosford and Woy Woy will be diverted via Woy Woy Rd.

Motorists should avoid the area during the event but if travel is necessary, allow extra travel time and follow the directions of traffic controllers.

properties.publicTransport: Match tickets include travel on trains. Visit transportnsw.info to plan your trip.
properties.otherAdvice:
NRL: Sharks v Dragons at Sharks Stadium in Woolooware. Kick-off 7.50pm, full time around 9.50pm.

Road closures may be in place on Captain Cook Dr from approximately 10 minutes before kick-off and remain in place until crowds have cleared around 30 minutes after full-time.

Traffic on roads approaching the stadium will be heavier than usual as fans travel to the match.

Allow extra travel time on Captain Cook Dr, Woolooware Rd and Gannons Rd. 

Motorists should also be aware of increased pedestrian activity in the area.
